summary: Aalen's central garages (Rathaus P1, Reichsstädter Markt P2, Spritzenhausplatz P3, Spitalstraße P5, station P&R P6) are run by the municipal Stadtwerke Aalen, which raised garage tariffs in January 2024 and again in January 2026 (daily maximum 12.50 euros, night tariff limited to midnight-6 a.m.); the Mercatura garage is privately run and was outside the 2024 change. Counted short-term parking in the five Stadtwerke facilities rose from 763,584 cars in 2023 and 805,539 in 2024 to 1,031,224 in 2025, and the Stadtwerke expect about 195,000 euros of extra revenue from the 2026 prices while still planning a low six-figure deficit. On-street fees follow the Parkgebührensatzung of May 2017 (50 cents per 20 minutes, 120-minute maximum), the state announced 334,015 euros of funding in 2020 for a planned parking guidance system, and in January 2026 the Gemeinderat voted to have camera scan vehicles for parking enforcement examined, with a decision still to come. In April 2026 the city said public EV charging covered about 75 percent of 2026 demand.

items.text: In July 2014 city manager Reinhard Skusa said that 64 percent of users of the Stadtwerke garages and underground car parks were short-term parkers, who could park free for 30 minutes at that time, and that about 600,000 of the roughly one million parking transactions counted there each year were free; as a rule of thumb he said that in a city of about 70,000 residents people accept a walk of up to 700 metres for free parking.
items.source_title: Welcher Typ sind Sie?

items.text: At the end of December 2015 it was reported that the Rathaus underground garage (255 spaces) would be fully closed from 11 January 2016 until, as expected, 31 May 2016 for refurbishment costing about 4 million euros (121 of its spaces had been unavailable since 14 September 2015). With the demolition of the Kaufland building at the end of January 2016 its car park would also be lost, and about 40 surface spaces behind the former Kaufring were already unusable. The city and city manager pointed to alternatives including the Reichsstädter Markt garage (409 spaces, 114 of them short-term) and about 80 newly created free central spaces.
items.source_title: „Wo parken?“, fragen sich die Aalener

items.text: The Aalen Gemeinderat adopted the on-street Parkgebührensatzung on 18 May 2017, in force from 1 September 2017: 50 cents per 20 minutes at meters and parking machines (maximum parking duration 120 minutes), 50 cents for up to 20 minutes and 1 euro for up to 40 minutes at the railway station, and at the Platanenweg machines (Ostalbklinikum) 1 euro up to 45 minutes rising to a 6 euro day ticket (up to 11 hours). It replaced the 2004 ordinance.
items.source_title: Satzung über die Festsetzung der Gebühren für das Parken der Stadt Aalen (Parkgebührensatzung)

items.text: The Stadtwerke Aalen opened the Parkplatz Kubus above the Rathaus garage entrance on 6 October 2017 with 35 spaces, open 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. (exit possible at any time), charging the same fees as the Spitalstraße, station P&R and Rathaus garages.
items.source_title: Ab jetzt gibts 35 Plätze auf dem Parkplatz Kubus

items.text: In December 2017 the Aalener Nachrichten reported that from the end of January 2018 the first 20 minutes would be free in the Stadtwerke garages (a free 30-minute 'Brötchentarif' introduced in September 2016 had been dropped with the fee increase of 1 January 2017), and that shops would hand out 50-cent 'Spiontaler' parking coins for purchases of 25 euros or more, a concept reported to cost the Stadtwerke about half a million euros and still awaiting BaFin approval.
items.source_title: Brötchen-Tarif kehrt zurück, Spiontaler kommt

items.text: The Tiefgarage Spritzenhausplatz (P3) had been renovated over about a year; in January 2018 local traders and the Stadtwerke announced a February 2018 promotion in which  customers who spent at least 25 euros in participating shops could park free for up to eleven hours, to raise awareness of the renovated garage.
items.source_title: Wer einkauft, parkt gratis

items.text: On 14 May 2020 the Baden-Württemberg interior ministry announced 334,015 euros of InKoMo funding for the City of Aalen's planned dynamic, intelligent parking guidance system, combining sensor technology, a data platform and an app-based guidance system, with an AI analysis tool to forecast available parking spaces.
items.source_title: 1,7 Millionen Euro für digitale Mobilitätslösungen – Beschreibungen und Zitate zu den fünf ausgezeichneten Projekten

items.text: From 1 December 2020 Stadtwerke Aalen energy customers could take out an evening parking subscription (Feierabendtarif) valid at the Rathaus, Reichsstädter Markt, Spitalstraße, Spritzenhausplatz and railway-station garages on weekday evenings from 6 p.m., Saturdays from 2 p.m. and Sundays; 29 euros a month for the first six months, then 39 euros, with a minimum one-year contract.
items.source_title: Neuer Dauerparktarif für Energiekunden - Stadtwerke Aalen führen Feierabendtarif ein - Stadt Aalen

items.text: In June 2021 the city administration proposed one free hour of parking (instead of 20 free minutes) in municipal parking facilities from July to September 2021 to revive the city centre after the pandemic, at an estimated cost of about 15,000 euros a month; a vote was scheduled for 24 June 2021 (the outcome is not given in the article).
items.source_title: Parken: Wird die erste Stunde frei?

items.text: In February 2022 Oberbürgermeister Frederick Brütting decided that the city's general Parkgebührensatzung would apply at the Kulturbahnhof (KubAA) car park, which had not previously been part of the city's parking-management concept: 50 cents for the first 20 minutes and 50 cents per further started 20 minutes. He described this as a reduction of fees for guests and pointed to the P&R garage at the main station with its night tariff, the free Charlottenstraße lot and 60 bicycle spaces as alternatives.
items.source_title: Stadt bezieht Stellung zu Parkgebühren

items.text: Stadtwerke Aalen announced new garage tariffs from 1 January 2024 for its facilities (Spitalstraße, Reichsstädter Markt, station, Rathaus, Spritzenhausplatz, Kubus): first 20 minutes still free, first full hour 1 euro, second hour 1 euro, from the third hour 1.50 euros per started hour, daily maximum 12 euros; the last increase had been in 2018. The Mercatura shopping-centre garage is run separately by B+B Parkhaus GmbH & Co. KG and was not covered by the change.
items.source_title: Ab Januar wird Parken in Aalen teurer

items.text: In the December 2023 budget debate the Gemeinderat adopted a CDU motion for an overall concept on city-centre mobility covering parking, park-and-ride, cycling and public transport, and accepted a CDU motion on the land opposite the Kulturbahnhof, with the administration saying it would continue its talks with Deutsche Bahn about the plots in the first half of 2024 to create extra parking there. An AfD request to extend free parking in the Stadtwerke garages from 20 minutes to one hour was rejected. Spaces at the former Westparkplatz (Gaulbad) had already gone, and more along Stuttgarter Straße were expected to go when it is redesigned.
items.source_title: Am Kubaa und in der Aalener Innenstadt mehr Parkplätze gewünscht

items.text: In August 2024, responding to an FDP programme 'Politik für das Auto' that includes dropping parking charges, Oberbürgermeister Brütting called the programme a regression to the 1970s ('Rückfall in die 1970er'), while Freie Wähler leader Claus Albrecht, a retail representative, said free parking was not the answer and that more affordably priced spaces were needed, citing a Handelsverband Baden-Württemberg survey of 60 southwest cities in which 70-80 percent of visitors travel by car. The article also reports that an intelligent parking guidance system recording 2,000 spaces digitally had gone into operation a few days earlier.
items.source_title: Kein kostenloses Parken in Aalen

items.text: In October 2024 Stadtwerke Aalen was equipping its garages with electronic licence-plate recognition by the end of the year (Rathaus P1 with the Kubus lot, Reichsstädter Markt P2, Spritzenhausplatz P3, Spitalstraße P5 and the station P&R garage P6). P5 had been converted first as a trial, P3 followed on 16-18 September and P6 on 23-25 September; the P2 conversion was postponed from 7-9 October to 11-13 November 2024 and P1 was still scheduled for 4-6 November. During a conversion the garage cannot be entered from 6 a.m. on the Monday until 7 a.m. on the Wednesday.
items.source_title: Umrüstung des Parkhauses Reichsstädter Markt verschoben

items.text: In the council meeting before 19 December 2024 the Gemeinderat unanimously passed a basic resolution (Grundsatzbeschluss) to pursue extending the pedestrian zone to Rittergasse and parts of the Südlicher and Östlicher Stadtgraben; planning is now to be developed further, and the mayor said one to two years would be needed to clear open questions. The federal programme 'Zukunftsfähige Innenstädte und Zentren' has put 409,000 euros of funding in prospect. Oberbürgermeister Brütting called the traffic situation 'highly complex' and, when a councillor asked for a parking concept, spoke of a possible parking garage on the east side of the centre.
items.source_title: Aalener Fußgängerzone soll erweitert werden: Grundsatzbeschluss im Gemeinderat

items.text: From 1 January 2025 Stadtwerke Aalen introduced commuter products at the station P&R garage (P6): 45.50 euros monthly, 136.50 euros for six months and 253.50 euros a year (proof of rail commuter status required), and lowered the occasional-parker caps to 6 euros a day (from 10) and 8 euros per 24 hours (from 12).
items.source_title: SWA führen machen Pendlern neue Angebote im Park & Ride Parkhaus am Bahnhof (P6)

items.text: The start-up PEUKA launched in Aalen in January 2025 with 20 bookable private parking spaces (18 in the centre) at 0.40-1.00 euro an hour; Aalen's city manager questioned the model's viability for a mid-sized city because municipal garages already have ample evening capacity.
items.source_title: Gegen Parkplatznot in Aalen: private Stellflächen clever teilen

items.text: Stadtwerke Aalen announced a new garage tariff from 1 January 2026: 0.50 euro for up to 30 minutes (free for energy customers with the customer card), 1 euro for the first hour, 1.50 euros per further hour, daily maximum 12.50 euros, night rate (midnight-6 a.m.) 4 euros maximum, and about 8 euros gross more per month for permit holders.
items.source_title: Stadtwerke Aalen erhöhen Parkgebühren – Rabatte für Energiekunden

items.text: In January 2026 the Gemeinderat voted to explore using camera scan vehicles for parking enforcement (proposed by the Greens, aimed at sidewalks, bike lanes, school areas and resident-parking zones); the administration will first evaluate pilot projects in other cities such as Mannheim and Heidelberg before a final decision.
items.source_title: „Gute Idee“: Mit einer neuen Technik soll es Falschparkern an den Kragen gehen

items.text: Short-term parking at the five Stadtwerke Aalen facilities rose from 763,584 vehicles in 2023 and 805,539 in 2024 to 1,031,224 in 2025, with December the peak month at most sites; the Stadtwerke expected the January 2026 price changes to bring about 195,000 euros of extra revenue while still forecasting a low six-figure deficit for 2026.
items.source_title: Stadtwerke-Parkhäuser: Rekordnutzung und finanzielle Auswirkungen
